title: Layer gate position in the gate list
statement: Let $F$ be a finite layered Boolean circuit whose gates use only identity, NOT, and unbounded fan-in AND operations. For a layer $m$ below the circuit depth and a node $u$ in the successor layer, if the index given by the cumulative number of nodes in earlier successor layers plus the rank of $u$ in its layer is within the list of gates through layer $m$, then the gate at that index is precisely the gate associated with $u$ in layer $m$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a layered circuit over $\\mathrm{Fin}\,2$ with $n$ inputs and output type $\mathrm{Unit}$
Every gate operation of $F$ is identity, NOT, or unbounded fan-in AND
$u$ is a node in the successor of layer $m$
The specified index is less than the length of the gate list through layer $m$
